patch_description: Add a perturbation-based iterated local search (ILS) on top of the existing local search: (1) accept equal-score moves in the local search occasionally to enable escaping flat basins, (2) add pairwise swap moves between GPUs, and (3) apply a few random perturbations (random model relocation to a feasible GPU) followed by re-running local search, keeping the best solution found. Runtime remains tiny since problem sizes are small, and the best-found solution is always returned.
